title: AISafetyBenchExplorer: A Metric-Aware Catalogue of AI Safety Benchmarks Reveals Fragmented Measurement and Weak Benchmark Governance

bias_targets.methodology: The paper conducts a meta-analysis of existing AI safety benchmarks, evaluating and cataloging how bias metrics are operationalized across the literature (e.g., identifying the use of likelihood gaps, disparity measures, stereotype completion, or demographic answer shifts to measure group-conditioned behavior).
